description: Source code for PUCCH power control support in a 5G NR scheduler, implementing power control algorithms, SINR updates, and resource configuration.

classes.name: pucch_power_controller
classes.description: Class managing PUCCH power control, SINR updates, and resource configuration for 5G NR.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures PUCCH resource formats and power control settings based on UE configuration.

methods.name: get_tpc
methods.description: Calculates the transmit power control command based on SINR difference.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f0_f1
methods.description: Updates SINR measurements for PUCCH format 0/1 based on received signal quality.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f2_f3_f4
methods.description: Updates SINR measurements for PUCCH formats 2/3/4.

methods.name: update_pucch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Stores PUCCH power control data and delta TF calculations for a given slot.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Computes the TPC command for a specific PUCCH slot based on SINR targets.
